benefits.headline: The hard parts? We handle those.
benefits.subheadline: Diets fail because they ask too much of you. Wondish does the opposite — it removes the friction so the healthy choice is the easy one.
benefits.b1Desc: Your daily targets are baked into every meal. Just cook, eat, and trust the plan — the math is already done for you.
benefits.b2Desc: Real meals you'll look forward to — never the same boring week twice, and nothing you secretly hate.
benefits.b3Desc: A smart shopping list builds itself from your week, organized aisle by aisle.
benefits.b4Desc: Don't fancy tonight's dinner? Swap it for something that fits your exact targets in a single tap — or regenerate the whole week. Your plan flexes around your real life, not the other way around.

conditions.headline: Care that meets you where your health is.
conditions.subheadline: Some bodies need a little more attention — and we're here for that too. Wondish tailors your meals to all the conditions you live with, so eating will never mean eating with worry.
conditions.c1Desc: Personalized, nutrient-rich meals designed to support strength, energy, and quality of life.
conditions.c2Desc: Anti-inflammatory meals designed to support energy and overall well-being.
conditions.c3Desc: Lower-glycemic meals that help keep your blood sugar steady and predictable.
conditions.c4Desc: Lower-sodium, heart-smart plans rich in the foods your cardiologist would cheer for.
conditions.c5Desc: Celiac, nut, dairy and more — flagged and filtered out of every single dish.
conditions.c6Desc: Gentle, fibre-considered plans that are kind to a sensitive stomach.
conditions.note: Wondish supports your health journey but isn't a substitute for medical advice — we'll always nudge you to loop in your doctor.

quotes.headline: The easiest healthy habit they've kept.
quotes.q1: I've tried every diet going. This is the first one that didn't feel like a diet at all — I lost 9kg and never once felt hungry or deprived.
quotes.q2: As a type 2 diabetic, meal planning was stressful. Wondish keeps my sugars steady and the food is genuinely delicious. Total peace of mind.
quotes.q3: The grocery list alone saves me an hour every week. I open the app, cook, and somehow I'm eating better than I ever have.
quotes.q4: At the start of my cancer treatment, I was living alone. I was just ordering food because everything felt too hard to handle. But most of the time it made my nausea worse and I didn't feel well at all. Wondish and a personal chef changed everything. I finally had meals I could count on and could eat what my body needed during those difficult days.
quotes.q5: Before Wondish, I was always hungry. I often went back for a second serving because I never felt satisfied. Now I start to feel full before I even finish my meal. It's completely changed the way I eat.
quotes.q5Meta: Managing autoimmune disease and weight loss
quotes.q6: Just two weeks after removing the foods that were triggering my symptoms for years, I started noticing less inflammation and less pain.
quotes.q7: I had been eating the same way my whole life. I never imagined my food could be causing my symptoms. Wondish helped me eat the foods that make me feel better.
